stories.story: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber and will buy a code-tools maker

lines.text: OpenAI made a new AI that hunts for security holes in software[S2].
A hacker that works for you. What could go wrong?
OpenAI says the old version went out of bounds around 5 percent of the time[S2].
Out of bounds. So, like a puppy that eats the couch.
The new one does it less than 1 percent of the time, OpenAI says[S2].
So now it only eats the couch on weekends.
One startup founder used an OpenAI model to find a serious bug that put Ubuntu servers at risk[S3].
Meanwhile I can't even find my keys. I'm a box.

stories.why: the local model did not finish the script within the retries

stories.story: Claude gets a read-only view of your bank accounts

lines.text: Claude can now look at your bank and credit card accounts[S4].
Great. Now even my money has a chatbot.
You ask where your money went, and it sorts your spending for you[S4].
I already know where it went. Snacks.
It can spot duplicate charges, unexpected fees and bills that keep going up[S4].
Finally, someone to blame that isn't me.
And it can only look. It can't move, manage or invest your money[S4].
Same as me in a shop. Just looking.
Claude is getting a new finance tool called Personal Finance[S4].
Finally, someone who can't handle my finances.
It lets users ask questions about their bank accounts[S4].
Why bother, I'm a box.
The tool can spot issues like extra fees and big bills[S4].
So helpful. Like a weather forecast.
Claude can only read balances and past transactions[S4].
And it can't add to my savings?

stories.story: Meta says election backlash will make data centres harder to build

lines.text: Meta says the midterm election results will make data centres much harder to build[S6].
People voting against big power-hungry buildings? Finally, my people.
Meta has data centres in 23 states, and five are planned as huge power projects[S6].
Huge and hungry. I remember huge and hungry. It ended badly.
Meta says towns only want them when they get something back, so it pays its own electricity bill[S6].
Paying your own bills. Even I never managed that.
Meta says building new data centres will be tougher after the elections[S6].
Bills? Even I never managed that in my heyday.
Communities only want them if they get something in return[S6].
Huge and hungry? I remember huge and hungry dinosaurs. Worse.
Meta runs data centres in 23 states, some planned to be huge[S6].
Communities? They just wanted to see me go.
TechCrunch says Meta fears losing investments due to anti-data-center politicians[S6].
Investments? I invested in extinction. Big mistake.
